text.section:
A casino gaming operator may offer on-premises mobile casino gaming only to an individual who has established an on-premises mobile casino gaming account and uses such account to place wagers as follows:
Any wager shall be placed directly with the casino gaming operator by the account holder;
The casino gaming operator shall verify the account holder's physical presence on the premises of the casino gaming establishment; and
The account holder shall provide the casino licensee with the correct authentication information for access to the wagering account.
A casino gaming operator shall not accept a wager in an amount in excess of funds on deposit in the account of the individual placing the wager.
